method: 30 synthetic, non-branded Russian-language buyer-intent prompts, authored from prior role12 taxonomy and real service scope. They are NOT observed verbatim purchaser logs and NOT yet run as independent LLM answers.
market_intent: Russia/CIS primary; search engine location is not implied by query language

measurement_contract.required: query_id, exact_prompt, provider/model/version if known, search_or_no_search_mode, run_utc, locale, complete answer or permissible short excerpt, exact citation URLs, brand_mentioned, specialty_correct, first_party_cited, independent_source_cited, confusable_entity, negative/outcome, followup
measurement_contract.model_status: NOT_RUN as of 2026-10-25; web retrieval proxy recorded separately

prior_baseline: ops/role12/search_12_queries_2026-10-20.json (12 different web-search queries, 8 RU/2 EN/2 TH); do not merge counts
exclusions: No claims of platform market share, Top-5 model ranking, or customer queries from authored prompts
No promotion of unapproved private ChatGPT plugins as publicly installable
No invented completed fashion catalog, museum installation, film commission or Auto.ru campaign
Website releases and technical crawl belong to owner and role12
